skill.name: api-spectral
skill.description: Validate OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, and Arazzo specifications with Stoplight Spectral. Use OWASP API Security rules, custom governance checks, and CI templates to find design and security issues early.
skill.summary: Lint API specifications with Spectral security rules and OWASP API guidance.
skill.author: AgentSecOps

security_audit.summary: Most static detections are false positives from Markdown examples, Spectral rule templates, and defensive security references. The actionable risk is supply-chain exposure in CI templates that download remote content from branch URLs, including a curl-to-bash installer. No prompt injection language was found in the reviewed skill files.

remediation.issue: Remote installer piped to shell in the CI template.
remediation.suggestion: Replace the curl-to-bash tfsec install with a pinned action, package manager install, or checksum-verified release artifact.

remediation.issue: Workflow templates download raw GitHub files from mutable branch URLs.
remediation.suggestion: Vendor helper scripts and rulesets, or pin immutable commit URLs with checksum verification before execution.

remediation.issue: Reusable CI examples need clearer production hardening guidance.
remediation.suggestion: Add comments requiring review of workflow permissions, token scope, downloaded tool versions, and artifact retention.

- `generate_remediation.py` - Generate remediation guidance based on Spectral findings
- `compare_spectral_results.py` - Compare two Spectral scans to track remediation progress
- `aggregate_api_findings.py` - Aggregate findings across multiple API specifications
- `spectral_ci.sh` - CI/CD integration wrapper with exit code handling
- `generate_pr_comments.py` - Convert Spectral findings to PR review comments

- `ruleset_patterns.md` - Reusable ruleset patterns for common security scenarios

semantic_findings.title: Unpinned Remote Downloads in CI Templates
semantic_findings.description: Reusable workflow templates download scripts or rulesets from mutable raw GitHub branch URLs. One template also pipes a remote installer directly to bash, creating CI supply-chain exposure.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The templates explicitly download remote content during CI, and the parser script is executed later in the job. The tfsec installer is piped to bash with no pinning or checksum, so the supply-chain risk is clear.

content.value_statement: API teams need consistent security checks before implementation and release. This skill guides Spectral linting, OWASP API rule mapping, and CI validation workflows.
actual_capabilities: Guides Spectral setup and lint commands for OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, and Arazzo specifications.
Provides an OWASP API Security Top 10 ruleset in assets/spectral-owasp.yaml.
Includes rule examples for SQL injection, hardcoded secrets, XSS, and weak cryptography.
Provides GitHub Actions templates for Spectral linting and broader security scanning.
Explains custom rule authoring, result review, and OWASP mapping workflows.
limitations: It does not execute Spectral by itself; users must install and run the CLI.
Referenced helper scripts are described but are not included in this shard.
Lint results need manual review because API context can change severity.
CI templates need version pinning and integrity review before production use.

use_cases.title: Standardize API Design Checks
use_cases.description: Create shared Spectral rules so teams follow the same security and governance requirements.

use_cases.title: Review Security Before Merge
use_cases.description: Use OWASP API rules to review OpenAPI changes and prioritize risky design findings.

use_cases.title: Add CI API Linting
use_cases.description: Adapt the workflow templates to run Spectral checks and publish review feedback in pull requests.

prompt_templates.title: Check One API Spec
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner validation of a single OpenAPI file.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my OpenAPI specification with Spectral security rules. List the highest priority issues and explain each fix in simple terms.

prompt_templates.title: Create OWASP Rules
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate setup for API security coverage.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me create a Spectral ruleset for OWASP API Security Top 10 risks. Focus on authentication, HTTPS, sensitive data, and SSRF.

prompt_templates.title: Tune CI Enforcement
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced rollout in pull request workflows.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a CI workflow for Spectral API linting. Start with warnings, then move to blocking error-level security findings.

prompt_templates.title: Govern API Portfolio
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced governance across many API specifications.
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a Spectral governance process for many API specs. Include rule ownership, exception handling, reporting, and remediation tracking.

output_examples.input: A payment OpenAPI file has public endpoints and missing security requirements.
output_examples.output: The review highlights unauthenticated operations, missing HTTPS enforcement, and rules to verify sensitive response fields.

output_examples.input: A team wants to add Spectral checks to pull requests.
output_examples.output: The workflow plan separates install, lint, report, and failure steps, with a recommended severity threshold for rollout.

output_examples.input: An organization needs custom rules for API governance.
output_examples.output: The guidance defines rule names, severity levels, OWASP mappings, test cases, and remediation messages for consistent adoption.

best_practices: Pin tool versions and review workflow permissions before using CI templates.
Start with high-confidence security rules, then expand coverage after reviewing false positives.
Map each custom rule to a clear risk, owner, and remediation path.
anti_patterns: Do not block builds on every warning before teams understand the findings.
Do not include real credentials, internal hostnames, or sensitive examples in API specs.
Do not copy remote download steps into CI without pinning and integrity checks.

faq.question: Does this skill run Spectral automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance, rulesets, and workflow templates. You run Spectral in your environment.

faq.question: Which API formats are covered?
faq.answer: The guidance covers OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, and Arazzo where Spectral supports those formats.

faq.question: Can I use this with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The marketplace metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: Are the OWASP rules complete?
faq.answer: They provide a practical starting point. You should tune rules for your API architecture and risk model.

faq.question: Can the CI templates be used as-is?
faq.answer: Review them first. Pin versions, remove unneeded downloads, and scope tokens before production use.

faq.question: Will Spectral find every API vulnerability?
faq.answer: No. Spectral checks specification patterns. Runtime testing, threat modeling, and code review are still required.
